item.summary: fix(gateway): give prepared chat.send media one abandonment-discard owner (#124100) #123983 fixed two of six pre-persistence exits that orphan staged inbound media (~/.openclaw/media/inbound has no transcript reference until the user turn persists, and the inbound sweep is off by default). Four sibling exits still leaked: the post-reply-context abort and routing-change checks, the pre-ACK injection settle (onAborted/onActiveLeafChanged), and any setup throw routed to handleChatSendSetupError. Instead of adding four more inline discards, the custody moves to the admission cleanup owner: every abandonment exit already funnels through cleanupAdmittedRun, which now fires an armed discard gated on the user-turn recorder's persisted fact (the restart-safe path persists durably before its exits; steer injections carry the same recorder). The ACK disarms it because dispatch's error lifecycle persists the referencing transcript on every post-ACK path. The two inline discards #123983 added are deleted. Regression test drives the setup-error exit with an offloaded attachment and fails pre-fix; the original #123983 abort test still passes through the new owner.
